verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents encrypted state backends and hands-on probe evidence confirms secrets are encrypted using PULUMI_CONFIG_PASSPHRASE even on a local file backend, verifying secret values are not stored in plaintext. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of KMS/cloud secrets-provider options for encrypting the whole state, independent third-party verification of encryption strength, and clarity on whether non-secret resource properties are also encrypted at rest.
